whatsapp_ticket_submissions.description: Durable work and outcome for one verified, confirmed WhatsApp draft submitted to GLPI.
whatsapp_ticket_submissions.lifecycle: Starts when an employee confirms a draft. Confirmed ticket creation clears the work summary. Terminal results clear the active reply address and media references. Retain durable outcomes for reconciliation and deduplication under the project retention policy.

draft_id.description: Unique opaque identifier of the confirmed draft and GLPI reconciliation reference.

business_phone_id.description: Meta business phone number ID owning the submission job.

scope_key.description: Verified sender scope used to update the correct conversation.

requester_id.description: Verified GLPI requester chosen at confirmation.

recipient.description: WhatsApp address for the eventual response. Cleared at the terminal outcome.
recipient.nullMeaning: The submission no longer needs its reply address.

reply_expires_at.description: Deadline of the customer service window associated with confirmation.

title.description: Ticket title derived from the confirmed category. Cleared after creation or terminal failure.
title.nullMeaning: The title is no longer needed for creation.

description.description: Confirmed ticket summary with its opaque reconciliation reference. Cleared after creation or terminal failure.
description.nullMeaning: The summary is no longer needed for creation.

media_ids.description: Ordered Meta media identifiers to resolve at delivery time. Cleared when processing ends.

attachment_count.description: Number of media references in the confirmed draft.

next_attachment.description: Zero-based position of the next media reference to process.

attached_count.description: Number of documents whose association to the ticket was confirmed.

uncertain_attachments.description: Number of document writes whose association or outcome could not be confirmed.

ticket_id.description: Authoritative GLPI ticket ID returned by successful creation.
ticket_id.nullMeaning: GLPI has not confirmed a ticket for the draft.

state.description: Current dispatch or terminal state for the confirmed draft.

attempts.description: Number of worker claims for the current ticket or attachment step.

available_at.description: Earliest retry instant or deadline of the active worker claim.

claim_id.description: Temporary worker ownership token that fences stale writes.
claim_id.nullMeaning: No worker holds a claim for the current step.

mutating.description: Durable evidence that a non-idempotent GLPI mutation may have been started.

updated_at.description: Instant of the latest claim or durable progress transition.

closure_consent_id.description: Active notice grant recorded when the employee confirmed the draft.
closure_consent_id.nullMeaning: There was no eligible notice grant when this submission was queued.

closure_check_at.description: Time of the next GLPI closure check or the deadline of its active claim.
closure_check_at.nullMeaning: The watch is unscheduled, retired or has created a closure reply.

objects.whatsapp_ticket_submissions_pkey: Prevents two jobs for the same verified draft.
objects.whatsapp_ticket_submissions_dispatch_idx: Finds eligible jobs for one Meta business phone number.
objects.whatsapp_ticket_submissions_progress_che: Enforces consistent progress, result and claim counts.
objects.whatsapp_ticket_submissions_closure_watc: Requires a confirmed GLPI ticket and an explicit consent grant for any scheduled check.
objects.whatsapp_ticket_submissions_closure_idx: Finds due ticket closure checks within one business number.

enums.WhatsAppTicketSubmissionState: PENDING covers dispatch and bounded retries. COMPLETED confirms a ticket and records attachment outcomes. FAILED confirms no ticket was created. UNCERTAIN requires checking GLPI before a repeat.
